label: sdc02_0258_bbteacher_01
text: Oh, wonderful! This elevator just keeps going\nfurther and further down![VAR 0x0114(0042)]

label: sdc02_0258_sister_02
text: You know, it’s moving pretty fast, actually...\nIt almost feels like I’m floating![VAR 0x0114(0044)]

label: sdc02_0258_brother_02
text: That panel we used to unlock the gate...[VAR 0x0114(0043)]

label: sdc02_0258_brother_03
text: Didn’t it say something about where the elevator\ngoes?[VAR 0x0114(0043)]

label: sdc02_0258_sister_03
text: Now that you mention it, yeah... Something\nabout an elevator being redirected, right?[VAR 0x0114(0044)]

label: sdc02_0258_bbteacher_02
text:
As far as I know, there is only one elevator inside
the Zero Lab...\c
So the panel must have been referring to the
elevator we’re currently inside.[VAR 0x0114(0042)]

label: sdc02_0258_sister_04
text: So...where exactly is this thing taking us?[VAR 0x0114(0044)]
